definitions.gloss: column; vertical row; things arranged in a line from front to back
definitions.explanation: A line of people, vehicles, or objects arranged one behind the other, extending in depth rather than width. Also used for vertical columns in tables and charts.

examples.japanese: {縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: To line up in a column.

examples.japanese: {縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people find parallel parking difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}んで→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The soldiers formed a column and marched.

notes:
A compound of {縦|じゅう} (vertical, lengthwise) and ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line). Describes things arranged one after another in a line extending forward and back, as opposed to side by side.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧: parallel parking (literally 'column parking' — parking in single file along the curb)
- {縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up in a column
- {縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦{行進|こうしん}→行進：22196_koushin⟧: marching in column formation
- {縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to form a column

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {横列|おうれつ}: horizontal row — things arranged side by side in a line extending left and right
- ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧: row, line — a general term that can refer to any kind of line or queue
- ⟦{隊列|たいれつ}→隊列：27097_tairetsu⟧: formation, file — specifically a military or organized group marching in order

USAGE:
Despite the English term 'parallel parking,' the Japanese {縦列|じゅうれつ}⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}→駐車：01466_chuusha⟧ literally means 'column parking' — describing how the cars are lined up in single file along the street.
